senses.gloss:
Toyādrināthaprapatti
prob. by Veṅkaṭeśa, son of Prativādibhayaṅkara. MT. 143 (y).

Toyādrimāhātmya
on Tirunīrmalai near Madras. in 10 adhys. from Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa, Parāśarapuṇḍarīkasam3vāda. MD. 2441. 2442. 15300. 17031 (inc.).

Toyādrīśamaṅgalāśāsana
by Veṅkaṭeśa, son of Prativādibhayaṅkara. MT. 1453 (x).
